args.title: Add missing docs on setting S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO local usage
args.body:
File: README.md

The Running locally section should include instructions to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO locally. It should also mention that a bucket must be created in MinIO before running the service, to avoid confusion.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The reporter found that the README.md documentation is missing important details for using MinIO locally. It needs instructions on setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable and creating a bucket beforehand to avoid confusion.
